convert_task_to_parlai_format: run ConvertDataToParlaiFormat to convert a ParlAI task dataset to standardized text format and save to outfile
convert_task_with_num_examples: run ConvertDataToParlaiFormat with num-examples flag to convert only a subset of examples to text format
convert_task_ignore_fields: run ConvertDataToParlaiFormat with ignore-fields flag to exclude specific message fields from the output
compute_data_stats: run DataStats to compute and display token, utterance, and length statistics for a ParlAI task dataset
compute_data_stats_with_options: run DataStats with agent and ignore-tokens flags to compute filtered statistics for a specific agent
